# Daily Briefing – Monday 19 October

Yesterday was a rest day, which is fine, but 3.5 hours of sleep is a real concern. With only 4,622 steps and 2,283 calories burned, your body was ticking over quietly — but it wasn't getting the recovery it needed to actually rebuild.

Your HRV at 103ms sits just below your baseline range of 99–121ms, and paired with a stress score of 58, your nervous system is telling you it's still under pressure. Your resting HR of 51 is solid, but don't let that mask the bigger picture — sleep debt accumulates fast. Keep today's session easy if you run at all.

Tonight, make sleep your number one priority — genuinely aim for 7–8 hours. A magnesium-rich meal (spinach, pumpkin seeds, dark chocolate) in the evening can support deeper sleep and help bring that stress score down meaningfully.
